name: Relo Group, Inc.
summary: Relo Group, Inc. provides property management services in Japan. The company is involved in the leased corporate housing management business, including consulting on dormitories and corporate housing, unattended house management services, rental brokerage, and other real estate services. It also offers global relocation support services, such as consulting and training regarding overseas transfers and business trips, support for the acceptance of foreign employees, and services related to overseas transfer regulations and compensation; solutions for HR activities; research, sales, and consulting on various indices; and serviced apartment operation and management.
